description: Flake inputs pinned to an EXPLICIT revision inside the URL, e.g. `github:owner/repo/<40-char-sha>`. Tracked as git-refs digests against the default branch.

This does not conflict with the single-writer rule for flake.lock stated in renovate-nix.json. That rule exists because Renovate's `nix` manager and the weekly relock would both write flake.lock; this manager writes flake.NIX, proposing a newer revision for a pin the relock provably cannot move.

Verified by running the relock in a worktree: `nix flake update` advanced nixpkgs and dryvist-github, and left ai-llm-prompts and claude-code-plugins byte-identical. An explicit rev re-resolves to itself every week, so without this manager those two inputs are frozen permanently and nothing in the estate can ever propose a newer one.

A bump here leaves flake.lock stale. `nix flake check` does NOT catch that — it silently rewrites the lock in the working tree and exits 0, so CI goes green and the merge lands flake.nix and flake.lock disagreeing. The lock-consistency job in ci.yml is what turns that red; do not remove it while this manager exists.
